source_text.body:
Buy groceries through a Walmart+ account
A user gave Muse access to their Walmart+ account to buy groceries and tested it against manual shopping.
·
Oct 22, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The Reddit poster says they gave Muse access to their Walmart+ account, then ran a side-by-side test: they handed Muse a grocery list while manually shopping the same list in Walmart+. Muse appears to have worked through the Walmart site, and the poster also pasted the same list into Walmart’s own AI assistant, Sparky, for comparison; no extra human intervention is described beyond giving the prompts and account access.
How it went
Muse finished, but it took 7 minutes longer than the poster shopping manually. Sparky surfaced every item in chat with quantity controls and was described as faster than the human and about 10x faster than Muse.
Worth knowing
The main catch in this test was speed: the source says Muse lagged manual shopping by 7 minutes, while Walmart’s built-in assistant was much quicker.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Using my Walmart+ account, build a grocery cart from this list: [items and quantities], with a budget of [amount] and delivery or pickup on [date]. Substitute only with [my rules on substitutions]. Stop at checkout and show me the full cart and total, and do not place the order until I approve.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ValueInvesting/comments/1xhcwoa/metas_muse_will_be_a_complete_flop_tell_me_im
